description: This Java source file defines the 'Parameter' enumeration used for querying learning table values from an ECU in the RomRaider project. It specifies various parameters related to ECU data such as IAM, AF learning, and sensor voltages, with string representations and lookup methods.

classes.name: Parameter
classes.description: An enumeration representing various ECU learning parameters, with string labels and methods for retrieval based on string values.

methods.name: fromValue
methods.description: Retrieves the Parameter enum constant corresponding to the given string value, or null if not found.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string label associated with the enum constant.
